The component also supports the common properties [`id`](../common-properties/#id), [`hidden`](../common-properties/#hidden), [`grid`](../grid/), and [`pageBreak`](../page-break/).

| Property                                                                 | Type                           | Required | Default | Description                                                                                                                             |
| ------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ------------------------------ | -------- | ------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `type`                                                                   | `"SigningActions"`             | Yes      |         | Identifies which component type this configuration represents.                                                                          |
| `textResourceBindings`                                                   | `object`                       | No       |         | Connects component texts to text resources or expressions.                                                                              |
| `textResourceBindings.awaitingSignaturePanelTitle`                       | `string \| expression<string>` | No       |         | The title of the panel that is displayed when the user should sign                                                                      |
| `textResourceBindings.checkboxLabel`                                     | `string \| expression<string>` | No       |         | The text to display when a user is asked to confirm what they are signing                                                               |
| `textResourceBindings.checkboxDescription`                               | `string \| expression<string>` | No       |         | A text that describes the checkbox label in more detail if needed                                                                       |
| `textResourceBindings.signingButton`                                     | `string \| expression<string>` | No       |         | The text to display in the button that the user clicks in order to sign                                                                 |
| `textResourceBindings.noActionRequiredPanelTitleHasSigned`               | `string \| expression<string>` | No       |         | The title of the panel that is displayed when the user has signed and no further action is required                                     |
| `textResourceBindings.noActionRequiredPanelTitleNotSigned`               | `string \| expression<string>` | No       |         | The title of the panel that is displayed when the user has not signed and no further action is required                                 |
| `textResourceBindings.noActionRequiredPanelDescriptionHasSigned`         | `string \| expression<string>` | No       |         | The description of the panel that is displayed when the user has signed and no further action is required                               |
| `textResourceBindings.noActionRequiredPanelDescriptionNotSigned`         | `string \| expression<string>` | No       |         | The description of the panel that is displayed when the user has not signed and no further action is required                           |
| `textResourceBindings.noActionRequiredButton`                            | `string \| expression<string>` | No       |         | The text to display in the button that the user clicks in order to go to the inbox and no further action is required                    |
| `textResourceBindings.awaitingOtherSignaturesPanelTitle`                 | `string \| expression<string>` | No       |         | The title for the panel when the signing task is not ready for submit                                                                   |
| `textResourceBindings.awaitingOtherSignaturesPanelDescriptionNotSigning` | `string \| expression<string>` | No       |         | The description for the panel when the current user is not signing                                                                      |
| `textResourceBindings.awaitingOtherSignaturesPanelDescriptionSigned`     | `string \| expression<string>` | No       |         | The description for the panel when the current user has signed                                                                          |
| `textResourceBindings.submitPanelTitle`                                  | `string \| expression<string>` | No       |         | The title for the panel when the signing task is ready for submit                                                                       |
| `textResourceBindings.submitPanelDescription`                            | `string \| expression<string>` | No       |         | The description for the panel when the signing task is ready for submit                                                                 |
| `textResourceBindings.submitButton`                                      | `string \| expression<string>` | No       |         | The text to display in the button that the user clicks in order to submit the signing task                                              |
| `textResourceBindings.errorPanelTitle`                                   | `string \| expression<string>` | No       |         | The title of the panel that is displayed when at least one of the signees is invalid and thus has not received access to the form       |
| `textResourceBindings.errorPanelDescription`                             | `string \| expression<string>` | No       |         | The description of the panel that is displayed when at least one of the signees is invalid and thus has not received access to the form |
| `textResourceBindings.rejectModalTitle`                                  | `string \| expression<string>` | No       |         | The title of the modal that is displayed when the use clicked on the reject button                                                      |
| `textResourceBindings.rejectModalDescription`                            | `string \| expression<string>` | No       |         | The description of the modal that is displayed when the use clicked on the reject button                                                |
| `textResourceBindings.rejectModalButton`                                 | `string \| expression<string>` | No       |         | The text to display in the button that the user clicks in the modal in order to confirm reject of the signing task                      |
| `textResourceBindings.rejectModalCloseButton`                            | `string \| expression<string>` | No       |         | The text to display in the button that closes the modal without rejecting the signing task, i.e. continuing the signing                 |
| `textResourceBindings.rejectModalTriggerButton`                          | `string \| expression<string>` | No       |         | The text to display in the button that triggers the reject modal                                                                        |
